one_line: The paper applies MobileNetV2 and InceptionV3 deep-learning models to solar-panel fault detection within a university (Kangwon National University) solar–hydrogen energy system, integrated with a customized ISO 50001:2018 energy-management framework — an academic/renewable-energy context, not continuous-flow industrial production.
